presented_output_a: Customers with Enterprise accounts created after January 1, 2025, can restore archived workspaces. Restoration may take up to 48 hours.
presented_output_b: Only customers with Enterprise accounts created after January 1, 2025, can restore archived workspaces. Restoration may take up to 48 hours.

output_a.evidence: Accurate and natural, but omits the explicit exclusivity conveyed by “only,” weakening the account eligibility constraint.

output_b.evidence: Fully preserves the Enterprise-only eligibility, creation-date condition, restoration capability, and 48-hour maximum.

judgment.preference_evidence: B explicitly preserves the source’s “only” restriction; A merely states that qualifying customers can restore workspaces without clearly excluding others.
